name: paper2readerapp
description: Convert any research paper (PDF, LaTeX source + .bib, or an arXiv id/URL) into one self-contained, interactive single-column HTML reader app — never-cropped figures/tables, a pink-highlighter guided tour with sidenotes, clickable section summaries, full-reference citation popovers, an audio-player navbar with a Back button, and MathJax.
